channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Michele Tafoya wins Republican nomination in Minnesota Senate race
item.description: Former sports broadcaster Michele Tafoya won the Republican Senate nomination in Minnesota's Tuesday primary. Democrats were choosing between U.S. Rep. Angie Craig and Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] A Tampa boutique, Revive and Restore, offers free clothes to those in need
item.description: A Tampa boutique, Revive and Restore, goes viral on social media. The boutique helps people in need and those who are homeless by offering free clothes.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa's South Howard flood relief project nears critical council vote amid debate
item.description: A $100 million-plus stormwater project aimed at alleviating chronic flooding in South Tampa's Parkland Estates and Palma Ceia Pines neighborhoods is heading toward a pivotal vote.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump says advisers wanted him off Air Force One in Turkey due to threat
item.description: President Donald Trump confirmed Tuesday that he slipped away from Air Force One in Turkey because the Secret Service and military wanted him on a “different plane” due to a threat.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Dover cemetery crash: Man arrested after 32 graves damaged
item.description: Dozens of graves were damaged at the First Baptist Dover Cemetery after a car crashed and smashed through the property.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Youth sports posters vandalized at Seminole football and cheer facility; man arrested
item.description: A Seminole youth football and cheer organization is speaking out after six posters featuring its young athletes were vandalized. Leaders say the posters were a source of pride for the children, making the damage especially upsetting for the players and their parents.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Pasco County Schools launches all-in-one mobile app ahead of new school year
item.description: Pasco County Schools is rolling out an all-in-one app as students head back to class on Thursday morning.
